MINI-MINUTES FOR APR-28-2008 9:30 AM FOR DEPT 301

LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANTS RS GROUP COMPANIES INC, JOHN HAMILTON, STEPHEN STONHILL, AND JUDY HAMILTON'S MOTION TO QUASH SERVICE OF SUMMONS DUE TO LACK OF PERSONAL JURISDICTION IS GRANTED. THE MOTION IS NOT UNTIMELY, AND TO THE EXTENT IF WERE, THE COURT FINDS GOOD CAUSE TO CONSIDER IT. PLAINTIFF HAS NOT CARRIED HIS BURDEN OF PROVING JURISDICTION BY ADMISSIBLE EVIDENCE. AS TO JUDY HAMILTON, THERE IS NO EVIDENCE OF ANY CONTRACT OF ANY KIND WITH CALIFORNIA THAT COULD SUPPORT JURISDICTION. AS TO RSGC, PLAINTIFF HAS PRESENTED NO ADMISSIBLE EVIDENCE THAT ITS CLAIM ARISES OUT OF DEFENDANT'S ONE TIME VISIT TO CALIFORNIA TO PITCH A SECURITY IN WHICH PLAINTIFF DID NOT INVEST. AS TO JOHN HAMILTON AND STEPHEN STONHILL, IN ADDITION, PLAINTIFF HAS PRESENTED NO ADMISSIBLE EVIDENCE THAT EITHER INDIVIDUAL ACTED OTHER THAN IN HIS CAPACITY AS AN EMPLOYEE OR OTHERWISE SUBJECTED HIMSELF INDIVIDUALLY TO PERSONAL JURISDICTION. PLAINTIFF'S OBJECTIONS 4 THROUGH 13 ARE SUSTAINED BECAUSE STATEMENTS ABOUT SETTLEMENT TALKS ARE IRRELEVANT AND IMPROPER. PREVAILING PARTY TO PREPARE ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR# 8189

MINI-MINUTES FOR SEP-08-2008 9:30 AM FOR DEPT 301

LAW AND MOTION 301, THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS : DEFENDANT SANDRO SORDI'S MOTION TO QUASH SERVICE OF SUMMONS DUE TO LACK OF PERSONAL JURISDICTION IS GRANTED. NEITHER DEFENDANT'S APPEARANCES BY TELECONFERENCE AT MEETINGS OF A BOARD OF DIRECTOR'S NOR HIS EXECUTING IN CANADA AN AGREEMENT WITH A CALIFORNIA CONSULTANT ON BEHALF OF HIS OUT-OF-STATE EMPLOYER IS SUFFICIENT TO SUBJECT DEFENDANT TO GENERAL JURISDICTION. NOR IS THIS ACTION SUFFICIENTLY CONNECTED TO THE CONSULTING AGREEMENT TO GIVE RISE TO SPECIFIC JURISDICTION. DEFENDANT'S OBJECTIONS TO PORTIONS OF SEMIEN DECLARATION STATED ON INFORMATION AND BELIEF ARE SUSTAINED. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE A FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL A.
